facts.fact: Universal Ads announced that new partners are joining its Business Partner Program, naming six: Adrsta, Fospha, Lemonlight, M-Squared, Northbeam, and Stella.
facts.quote: Today, we’re excited to share that new partners are joining the Universal Ads Business Partner Program

facts.fact: Universal Ads describes its Business Partners Program as connecting advertisers with trusted ecosystem partners to help each brand launch, optimize, and prove performance on TV.
facts.quote: which connects advertisers with trusted ecosystem partners uniquely suited to help each brand launch, optimize, and prove performance on TV

facts.fact: Fospha brings daily media mix modeling to the Universal Ads partner ecosystem.
facts.quote: Fospha brings daily media mix modeling to the Universal Ads partner ecosystem

facts.fact: Lemonlight joins the Universal Ads program as a creative production partner, using its proprietary platform Hero that blends production expertise with AI-powered technology.
facts.quote: Lemonlight joins as a creative production partner

facts.fact: M-Squared's causal measurement framework combines MMM, incrementality testing, and geospatial analysis.
facts.quote: Through a combination of MMM (media mix modeling), incrementality testing, and geospatial analysis

facts.fact: Northbeam's Clicks + Deterministic Views connects CTV views to final conversions.
facts.quote: With Clicks + Deterministic Views, Northbeam connects CTV views to final conversions

facts.fact: Stella's platform is described as purpose-built for ecommerce and retail brands, combining incrementality testing, media mix modeling, and causal analysis for CTV spend.
facts.quote: Purpose-built for ecommerce and retail brands, Stella makes enterprise-grade causal measurement accessible

facts.fact: Universal Ads directs prospective partners and advertisers to universalads.com/partners to become a Business Partner or explore current partners.
